title: asset
description: Origin: v2 §15.5. The entity spine (U17). asset_key is stable within a tenant and survives IP change (NAT/DHCP). Keys are always (tenant_id, asset_key) — tenant isolation is a partition invariant.

username.description: U3a. Observed account on the entity. Set ONLY from observed evidence — never inferred.

role.description: U3a. Observed role (distinct from the shipped role_if_known). Set ONLY from observed evidence.

os_hint.description: U3a. Observed OS hint. Set ONLY from observed evidence — never asserted when unobserved.

criticality.description: U3a. Externally-assigned criticality (e.g. low/medium/high/crown-jewel). Set ONLY when supplied.

owner.description: U3a. Externally-assigned owner. Set ONLY when supplied.

applications.description: U3a. Observed applications. ponytail: item shape settles in U3b ingestion; unconstrained until then.

listening_services.description: U3a. Observed listening services. ponytail: item shape (bare string vs {port,proto}) settles in U3b ingestion.

certificates.description: U3a. Observed certificate identifiers. ponytail: item shape settles in U3b ingestion.

ja4.description: U3a. Observed JA4(+) fingerprints. ponytail: item shape settles in U3b ingestion.

attribute_provenance.description: U3a. Per-attribute provenance for the additive attributes above. A key present here records WHERE and WHEN that attribute was observed; an attribute absent here was NEVER observed (and therefore never inferred/asserted). Additive + nullable — shipped records omit it.

facts.description: U7 (design §13.4): temporal, evidence-backed facts. Each attribution carries a value, a validity interval [valid_from, valid_to), a confidence and an evidence-backed source. A changed value opens a NEW interval (valid_to on the prior); it never overwrites. valid_to null == still valid.
